title: Double check before you reorder on size and length.
text: Double check before you reorder on size and length.. I reordered this and thought it would be the same one I had previously ordered.  Beware and check before you order, I got one that was two inches longer than what I had ordered. So one side is shorter after spending over $80.00 for two shower curtains.
